newsitem.title: FRANCE: More forwarding agents join Traxon France.
newsitem.headline: More forwarding agents join Traxon France.

text.p: The number of French-based airfreight forwarders joining airfreight information system, Traxon, has risen significantly over the past few months, a Traxon official told Reuters.

"Since the beginning of 1997, a further eight forwarding agents have been linked to the system taking the overall number of agents in France to 37, representing a network of 126 offices," the official said.
The agents to sign up this year were Thyssen Haniel, Partnair and Jet Air Service (JAS), Jules Roy, Cosco, Logfret, K Line and within the past few weeks, Nippon Express, the official added.

"Along with our airline participants, around 75 percent of the French air cargo sector is now linked to Traxon including 19 out of the top 20 France-based IATA-registered agents in terms of turnover," he said.
The official said Traxon France' attention was now turned to increasing the volume of electronic messages transmitted via the system.
"Our objective is to realise a 50 percent increase in the volume of messages in 1997 compared to a ten percent rise in 1996."

Traxon's services include the provision of information on flights schedules, booking of shipments and tracing and tracking of shipments, reservation and transmission of air waybill information to airlines.

The full list of Traxon's airline participants worldwide reads: Air Canada, Air France, British Airways, Cargolux, Cathay Pacific Airays Ltd, Emirates, Finnair, Japan Airlines Ltd, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines, Korean Airlines Ltd, Lufthansa, Martinair, Royal Air Maroc,SAS, Singapore Airlines and Swissair. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
